Moving to Azure has resulted in increased scalability, enhanced collaboration, and improved security.

Known for its early adoption of modern technology, Godrej Group paved the way for Godrej Consumer Products to explore the benefits of cloud computing. Basis extensive market search and thorough evaluation of multiple platforms, Godrej Consumer Products found Microsoft Azure to be a standout choice to transition its on-premises SAP platform to SAP S/4HANA to cloud. Azure’s diverse portfolio of services, multi-geo presence, and on-demand cloud offerings made it a clear choice for Godrej to adopt cloud.

The migration was planned in four phases. The first phase laid the foundation with critical elements such as security, global connectivity, resiliency measures and a strong governance structure. Following a few dry runs and support from Microsoft global experts, Godrej Consumer Products identified the optimal configuration and roll-out schedule. In the second phase of execution, Godrej Consumer Products moved its workloads to Microsoft Azure with a downtime of 48 hours against an earlier estimation of 72-hours. The production data was over 2TB in size and migrated within just six hours.

With disaster recovery capabilities seamlessly integrated into the cloud environment, Godrej Consumer Products now has an availability rate of 99.9%, ensuring uninterrupted business continuity and greater resilience.
